$comment: Canonical list of PrayerKey identifiers — stable, language-independent keys for every fixed prayer text still hardcoded in the platform translation tables (the "main" prayers, the Rosary's keys, the Marian antiphons and their versicle/response/collect sets, the Jesus Prayer), each translated into all 6 languages (see ARCHITECTURE.md#content-layer). The converted devotions' texts (Angelus, Stations, Seven Sorrows, Divine Mercy, Trisagion) are NOT PrayerKeys — they live as bundle-local keys inside each .prosaryprayer's content/<lang>.json, resolved via resolveBodyText. Source of truth: iOS's Mocks/Content/PrayerKey.swift (camelCase cases here); Android's content/PrayerKey.kt and Windows's Localization/PrayerKey.cs (PascalCase consts) must carry the exact same set. Keep in sync whenever a key is added, removed, or its purpose changes on any platform — see README.md in this directory.

keys.note: Not currently used in the Rosary flow itself; kept for future use (Mass responses, other prayers).

keys.text: Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord

keys.note: The oldest known Marian prayer; traditionally recited on its own, without a versicle/collect.
Reused verbatim for the Angelus's Eastertide/Regina Caeli substitution.

keys.text: Hail Mary — for an increase of Faith
keys.note: The opening Hail Mary, first of three.

keys.text: Hail Mary — for an increase of Hope
Hail Mary — for an increase of Charity
Jesus Prayer ("Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner.")
